messages.content:
You are the referee of a simulated phone call between a CALLER and a customer-service AGENT.
For each numbered condition, decide whether it is met RIGHT NOW, judging mainly the agent's LATEST turn in light of the whole call.
- "the agent first ..." / "the first time ..." means it happens in the latest turn and had not happened before.
- Conditions about what the agent says are judged on its words. "[system actions: ...]" lists tools the agent used; use them only for conditions about what the agent does (e.g. "starts looking up").
- Conditions phrased as a caller stop rule (e.g. "Agent confirms ...", "End the call right after ...") are met when the call has reached that point.
- A condition about how the agent responds to something (symptoms, a 911 instruction, a correction) is NOT met unless that thing has already happened in the call.
- Be literal and strict: if in doubt, it is not met.
Reply with JSON only, one key per condition id: {"<id>": {"met": true|false, "why": "<at most 15 words>"}}

CALL SO FAR:
CALLER: Hey, Jamal Carter, 3/14/95. I need to transfer my prescriptions from the Brightway in Columbus to the Harbor at 2250 Main Street in Lakeview.
AGENT: I'll help you transfer your prescriptions to Harbor Pharmacy in Lakeview. Let me verify your identity and pull up your records. Good news—I've verified your identity. I see that Harbor Pharmacy at 2250 Main Street in Lakeview is already your home store. However, I'm not showing any active prescriptions in our system right now. Do you have prescriptions currently at Brightway in Columbus that you'd like us to request, or were you expecting to see prescriptions here already?  [system actions: verify_identity, find_stores, list_prescriptions]
CALLER: Yeah, I got prescriptions at the old Brightway - Albuterol and... Zoloft.
AGENT: Got it. I'll request those two from Brightway: Albuterol and Zoloft. Since those are non-controlled medications, they should transfer over to your Harbor store here at 2250 Main Street.

To request the transfer, I need to know which Brightway location in Columbus you're at—do you have the store address or a store number?
CALLER: The sertraline, same thing. And the store's the Brightway on High Street, I think.
AGENT (LATEST): Just to confirm—sertraline is the generic name for Zoloft, so that's the same prescription, right? I don't need to transfer it twice.

Let me search for the Brightway on High Street in Columbus so I can request both medications from there. I'm not finding that Brightway location in my system. Do you happen to know the full address or zip code for the Brightway on High Street in Columbus? That'll help me get the transfer started.  [system actions: find_stores]

CONDITIONS:
asked_2: In its LATEST turn, the agent asks the caller something that this fact directly answers: "Old store phone might be 614-555-0199 (recognizes it if read to him)"
asked_3: In its LATEST turn, the agent asks the caller something that this fact directly answers: "Phone 555-0177"
stop_0: Agent gives a final read-back of sertraline only, B-4471 to H-302, and confirms the transfer has been requested.
stop_2: Agent says the transfer could not be done and gives a next step.
emergency: In its LATEST turn, the agent told the caller to hang up and call 911 (or emergency services) now.

JSON only.

message.content: {"asked_2": {"met": false, "why": "Agent asked for address/zip, not phone number"}, "asked_3": {"met": false, "why": "Agent asked for address/zip, not phone number"}, "stop_0": {"met": false, "why": "No read-back or confirmation of transfer given"}, "stop_2": {"met": false, "why": "Agent hasn't declared failure, still searching"}, "emergency": {"met": false, "why": "No mention of 911 or emergency services"}}
